description: Reads the whole funnel of a webinar — unique visitors, registrations, live attendance, watched enough, offer shown, offer clicked, replay, purchased — with the step-to-step conversion rates, a ranking across the host's webinars and one sentence saying which step to fix first. Read-only, changes nothing. Use it when the host asks how the funnel converts, where people drop off, how the webinar compares to the others, or what to improve. Do not use it for single registrants (that is wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants) or for money in currency (that is wi_get_webinar_revenue_woocommerce). Rates need at least 20 people in the earlier step, otherwise the answer says 'not enough data' instead of a percentage. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step.

all.description: true compares all webinars and ranks them by volume.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

utm.description: Filter the whole funnel by one UTM value, e.g. a source such as facebook.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to rank all webinars of the host.

name: wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats
title: Read the webinar funnel and what to improve
